integrity: Exact analytical proof with an independent exact-rational full-joint finite checker; symbolic and asymptotic arguments provide the all-size proof, not the finite checks.
scientific_limitations: Two consecutive new-incidence counts from one initial infective; homogeneous finite population, constant transmission probability, synchronous conditionally independent infection and recovery; unknown possibility of an equivalent classical moment formula. No general long-lag or data-inference claim.
title: A sharp sign reversal for consecutive incidence in finite chain-binomial epidemics
